target.name: GaiaLab (deployed biomedical hypothesis-generation system)
target.version: production analysis archive, 4 June to 28 October 2026: 5,578 records, 5,504 carrying the full internal metric block

claim.text: The grounding value shown in the analysis interface as the headline grounding figure ("Grounded ratio"), including "complete grounding" (1.00) on 475 publicly reachable analyses.
claim.location: Preprint: Abstract and Results, 'Divergence by magnitude' (pp. 1 and 5)

result.summary: In 4,804 of 5,504 archived analyses (87.3%) the grounding value shown to users differed from the system's own trust-adjusted grounding value on the same record (mean 0.757 against 0.347). In 475 publicly reachable analyses the interface showed complete grounding (1.00) while the trust-adjusted value was 0.00; these runs were not empty. The system's own share-readiness flag was set on 0.56% of runs while the interface displayed complete grounding on 46.7%. A separate reconciliation found 18 committed leaves across 3 Bitcoin-anchored Merkle roots permanently unresolvable after a maintenance job deleted the records behind them.

findings.finding: The displayed grounding ratio was computed during synthesis, before evidence gating removed assertions, so it described a superseded object rather than the findings in the final record.
The mean (0.757 displayed against 0.347 trust-adjusted) hid 475 runs at 1.00 against 0.00 and 700 runs where the two were equal.
The grounding label, the citation grade and citation-F1 ordered the same runs differently; seven 'high' runs displayed 1.000 with mean citation-F1 under 0.25, four of them graded D.
The interface led with complete grounding on 46.7% of runs while the system's own share-readiness flag was set on 0.56%.

'81% validated' (12,588 of 15,479 ledger predictions with an outcome) counted a trial that already existed as a validation; under a definition requiring a trial registered after the prediction, the count is 0.
Of 47 Merkle roots reconciled against two tables, 40 resolve, 2 were re-committed (75 leaves), 2 were released by design (65 leaves) and 3 hold 18 leaves that can no longer be resolved.
Trigger provenance could not be determined for 46.0% of the anchored ledger.

On 31 October 2026, 48 catalog sources returned usable data; 14 failed (every request, answered without data, intermittent, or wrong data); 5 credential-gated sources were not checked, against a published headline that counted 48 of 75.

not_performed: C4: not performed. The 475 records were corrected by a read-path change; 'no stored record altered' rests on the design, not on record-by-record verification.
C1: per-record content hashes against stored rows were not checked; only Merkle roots were reconciled.
C2: model version and source versions per record were not examined; only trigger provenance.
N1, N2, N3: not run; they were added to the protocol after this audit.

cost.note: Read-only SQL queries against the production archive; no paid model calls. Auditor time was not recorded.

notes: Recorded retrospectively on 7 November 2026 (US Central time; sealed_at is 8 November in UTC), after the audit was published. The prediction seal began at entry REG-2026-003; this entry has no prediction, and its seal proves only that it has not changed since it was sealed.
Self-audit: the auditor built and operates the audited system, so the audit cannot establish independence. author_contacted is null because there is no separate author to contact.

Corrections published on the audited system's validation page as of 7 November 2026: https://www.gailabai.com/validation#correction-grounding-2026-10-29 (grounding headline, 29 Oct); #prediction-ledger-correction-2026-10-29 (prediction ledger, 29 Oct); #kegg-gene-resolution-correction-2026-11-01 (KEGG gene resolution, 1 Nov); #ledger-provenance-correction-2026-11-01 (where ledger predictions came from, 1 Nov); #source-audit-correction-2026-11-05 (what the data sources returned, 5 Nov); #validated-definition-correction-2026-11-06 (what 'validated' meant, 6 Nov); #lassa-v11-unscoreable-correction-2026-11-06 (LassaAI study cannot be scored, 6 Nov); #regulatory-safety-display-correction-2026-11-06 (safety lookups that showed reassurance, 6 Nov).

Finding F8's denominator (48 of 70 checked, or 48 of 63 live checked if shipped tables and the system's own model are also excluded) is under review; see the audited system's validation page for the published figure.
